reason: E1 directly shows that dropwise addition synchronizes reduction and yields solid-solution HEA nanocrystals, while one-pot synthesis gives phase-separated products, supporting the core premise. E2 demonstrates that single-phase HEA nanoparticles can form even with consecutive reduction when many elements are present under limited mobility, which partially supports the stochastic mixing premise but also indicates synchronization may not be strictly necessary, introducing a minor gap.
